title: Etale cohomology of a finite coproduct of geometric points
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $I$ be a finite set, and let $C=\coprod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the finite coproduct of copies of $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. For an abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], choose the geometric point $\bar c_i$ on the $i$-th summand, with geometric stalk $F_{\bar c_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then the etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] satisfies $H^q(C,F)=0$ for every $q>0$, and the canonical map $H^0(C,F)\to\prod_{i\in I}F_{\bar c_i}$ is an isomorphism (the product is finite).
